item.title: For Press: Canberra ACT - 12th May 1959
item.content:
FOR PRESS:

Mr. W.R. Cumming, C.V.O., Director-General of the visit of Princess Alexandra, is proceeding to Sydney and Brisbane for discussions with each of the State Directors for New South Wales and Queensland about the programme of Her Royal Highness' Australian visit.

Mr. Cumming will be in Sydney on May 12 and in Brisbane on May 13.

CANBERRA, A.C.T.
12th May, 1959.
